clock.cadence: audio frame boundary crosses to core through a toggle synchronizer; due-to-commit includes configuration and admission; no independent free-running producer clock

codec.format: I2S slave, signed16 MSB first, 32-bit slots, left when LRCLK=0; one BCLK delay after LRCLK edge
codec.conversion: signed24 arithmetic shift right 8, no gain, dither, resampling or channel swap
codec.mute: hardware MUTE low until clocks locked, codec configured and complete frame available; sticky transport/deadline/underrun fault mutes; explicit reset required

bus.control: PS M_AXI_GP0 to AXI4-Lite 32-bit; independent AW/W acceptance; stable read/write responses under backpressure
bus.wave: 64-bit HP0 read-only AXI3 subset, four 32-byte outstanding lines, IDs/RLAST/RRESP checked
bus.blocks: 64-bit HP1 command read and result write DMA; aligned INCR bursts never cross 4KiB; ordered responses and length checks; two descriptor slots with explicit ownership
bus.cache: PS flushes initialized ROM and command blocks before ownership transfer; dsb precedes descriptor doorbell; invalidates completed result buffer before reading; buffers and lengths cache-line aligned
bus.interrupt: level interrupt for completed block or sticky fault, W1C acknowledgement; no per-sample CPU interrupt

frames.input: initial state once and explicit external control events with native frame order; golden post-state never supplied as commands
frames.output: all four sends and 64 mixer cells retained in original order; selected signed24 mixer cells drive left/right diagnostic audio; complete XP DSP/LSP and full final stereo remain Phase 5
frames.pause: pause only at complete frame boundary, output silence while paused, resume preserves source frame order
frames.reset: assert mute, stop new DMA descriptors, drain accepted AXI, then clear core/CDC/FIFO/state and counters before ready
frames.deadline: 3125 core clocks from due request to commit including frame configuration; missing command, FIFO full, invalid command or DMA error stops and reports fault

midi.phase4: real Touhou MIDI diagnostic windows with original frame indices, independent Voice evolution and address-indexed private Wave ROM
midi.final: all seven complete MIDI timelines, effects and 8-second tails; synthetic cases or piano cannot replace Touhou playback

sources.reuse: board configuration and tool methods only; no OPNA RTL, bitstream, XSA, BSP or ELF dependency
